cd "/c/visual projects/alpha" && python - <<'EOF'
p='tools/compute/tk015-tobox-link.sh'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
s=s.replace('''    new="$d.links"; old="$d.files"
    rm -rf "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/D20/$day.links"; mkdir -p "$new"''','''    T="$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp"  # вне D20/: циклы сетки перебирают D20/*/
    new="$T/$day.links"; old="$T/$day.files"
    rm -rf "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp/$day.links"; mkdir -p "$new"''')
s=s.replace('rm -rf "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/D20/$day.files"','rm -rf "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp/$day.files"')
s=s.replace('''    day=$(basename "$d"); d="${d%/}"
''','''    day=$(basename "$d"); d="${d%/}"
    [[ "$day" =~ ^20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || continue
''')
s=s.replace('touch "$d.box-done" && rsync -a --remove-source-files -e "$SSHC" "$d.box-done"','mkdir -p "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp" && touch "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp/$day.box-done" && rsync -a --remove-source-files -e "$SSHC" "$HOME/alpha/epochs/$E/study/approaches/tobox-tmp/$day.box-done"')
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
bash -n tools/compute/tk015-tobox-link.sh && sed -n 14,45p tools/compute/tk015-tobox-link.sh
